title: State of GHO
tagline: A experimental project using the Aave GHO subgraph and building a discord bot to query it
description:
A experimental project using the Aave GHO subgraph and building a discord bot using nodejs and javascript to query it 
Query supply, suppliers, treasury mints, repayment, mints, flashmints, user information, reserves  and more GHO information
Hope to add more functionality as I go on with the project
